data.title: 安洁莉娜 · 橱窗里的点心
data.description: 她在橱窗前停下，指着一块草莓蛋糕，决定等送完最后一件包裹再回来。
data.camera: 中景，蛋糕橱窗与人物同框
data.promptProse: Standing on the sidewalk outside an artisan patisserie, Angelina rests her palms against the clear display glass, admiring an array of strawberry shortcakes and glazed fruit tarts. The warm amber glow of the bakery's interior spills across the brick facade.
data.animaCaption: Peering eagerly through the bakery window at the strawberry tarts, she makes a mental note to return after her deliveries.
